senses.example: En Navarra hay nieve en invierno.
senses.exampleGloss: There is snow in Navarre in winter.

alternatives.reason: The event of snow falling, not the substance.
Rain and snow mixed; common on Navarre winter days.
Ice pellets; a different weather noun.

notes: Scope navarre because snow is a real topic around Pamplona and the Pyrenees; the word itself is peninsular.
